title: English Practice Quiz 0806
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 01: Public Wi-Fi may be risky because:
options: Other users may attempt to intercept insecure traffic
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Other users may attempt to intercept insecure traffic. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 02: A one-time password should be:
options: Kept private and never shared with callers
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Kept private and never shared with callers. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 03: A privacy notice explains:
options: How personal information is collected and used
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: How personal information is collected and used. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 04: A data breach should be:
options: Reported promptly through the organisation's process
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Reported promptly through the organisation's process. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 05: Data minimisation means:
options: Collect only information needed for a stated purpose
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Collect only information needed for a stated purpose. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 06: Before clicking an unexpected login link, you should:
options: Verify the sender and use a trusted route to the service
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Verify the sender and use a trusted route to the service. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 07: A screen lock helps:

questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Prevent unauthorised access when a device is unattended. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 08: Personal data should be sent by:
options: An approved secure method to authorised recipients
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: An approved secure method to authorised recipients. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 09: An app permission request should be:
options: Reviewed to ensure it is necessary for the app's purpose
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Reviewed to ensure it is necessary for the app's purpose. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Digital Privacy and Cyber Awareness 10: A secure password reset should verify:
options: The identity of the person requesting the reset
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: The identity of the person requesting the reset. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
